data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Theonymos', meaning 'God's grace'. In Christian tradition, this name represents the divine presence and favor bestowed upon the bearer. The name Tonye carries the meaning “God's grace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Tonye usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
